title: E se…?
subtitle: Second conditional: situações imaginárias e conselhos.

can_do.text: Consigo imaginar situações diferentes da realidade e dar conselhos com "se eu fosse você".
can_do.source: CEFR (Conselho da Europa) — Interação oral: trocar opiniões, nível B1

guide.title: Second conditional: o mundo do "se"
guide.intro: Para imaginar algo que não é real agora (ou é improvável), o inglês usa if + passado e would no resultado: "If I had money, I would travel" = se eu tivesse dinheiro, viajaria.

points.en: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
points.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo, aprenderia a tocar violão.

points.en: If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
points.pt: Se eu ganhasse na loteria, compraria uma casa.

points.en: If I were you, I would talk to her.
points.pt: Se eu fosse você, falaria com ela.
points.note: Para conselhos: If I were you. "Were" vale para todas as pessoas.

points.en: What would you do if you lived abroad?
points.pt: O que você faria se morasse no exterior?
points.note: Pergunta: What would you do if...?

tips: Compare: "If it rains, I'll stay" (possível) × "If I were rich, I'd travel" (imaginário).
Na fala, would vira 'd: I'd, she'd, we'd.

items.en: If I had more money, I would travel.
options: Se eu tivesse mais dinheiro, viajaria.
items.answer: Se eu tivesse mais dinheiro, viajaria.

items.en: If I ___ rich, I would buy a big house.
items.why: Second conditional: if + passado. Com be, usamos "were".

items.en: If she had a car, she ___ drive to work.

items.pt: Se eu ganhasse na loteria, compraria uma ilha.
items.answer: If I won the lottery I would buy an island
items.display: If I won the lottery, I would buy an island.

items.en: What would you do if you ___ a million dollars?
items.why: Depois do if, use o passado: had.

items.en: I'd help you if I could.
If I ___ you, I would talk to her.
items.why: Conselho: If I were you (forma mais usada).

items.en: If I were you, I wouldn't buy that phone.
options: Se eu fosse você, não compraria esse celular.
Você não quer comprar esse celular.
items.answer: Se eu fosse você, não compraria esse celular.

items.en: I ___ quit my job. I like it!

items.pt: Se eu fosse você, eu iria ao médico.
items.answer: If I were you I would see a doctor
items.display: If I were you, I would see a doctor.
items.why: Conselho com If I were you + would.

items.en: What would you do in my situation?
options: O que você faria na minha situação?
O que você fez na minha situação?
O que você faz na minha situação?
items.answer: O que você faria na minha situação?
items.why: What would you do = o que você faria.

items.en: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
options: Se chover amanhã, vamos ficar em casa.
Se chovesse amanhã, ficaríamos em casa.
items.answer: Se chover amanhã, vamos ficar em casa.
items.why: If + presente + will = possibilidade real (first conditional).

items.en: If I lived near the beach, I ___ swim every day.
If you ___ tired, go to bed.

items.pt: Eu não faria isso se fosse você.
items.answer: I wouldn't do that if I were you
items.display: I wouldn't do that if I were you.
items.why: A ordem pode inverter: o if no fim, sem vírgula.

items.en: If we had a garden, we'd have a dog.
options: Se tivéssemos um jardim, teríamos um cachorro.
Temos um jardim e um cachorro.
items.answer: Se tivéssemos um jardim, teríamos um cachorro.

items.en: She would be happier if she ___ less.

items.pt: Se eu fosse rico, viajaria pelo mundo.
items.answer: If I were rich I would travel around the world
accept: If I were rich, I would travel around the world
If I was rich, I would travel around the world
If I were rich, I'd travel around the world

items.pt: Se eu fosse você, eu falaria com ele.
items.answer: If I were you I would talk to him
accept: If I were you, I would talk to him
If I were you, I'd talk to him

items.en: I'd buy a house if I had the money.
items.why: I'd é a forma curta de I would.

items.en: What would you do if you were me?

items.pt: Se eu tivesse tempo, eu te ajudaria.
items.answer: If I had time I would help you
accept: If I had time, I would help you
If I had time, I'd help you

lines: I don't know what to do. My boss is always angry with me.
options: If I were you, I would look for another job.
If I am you, I will look for another job.
If I were you, I look for another job.
items.answer: If I were you, I would look for another job.
items.why: Conselho: If I were you, I would...

lines: What would you do if you won the lottery?
Would you like to live on an island?
options: Maybe, but I would miss my family.
Maybe, but I will miss my family yesterday.
Maybe, but I miss my family would.
items.answer: Maybe, but I would miss my family.

items.en: If I were you, I would rest.
items.pt: Se eu fosse você, eu descansaria.

items.en: I'd love to travel more.

lines: I'm afraid of flying, but I want to visit my sister.
options: If I were you, I'd take the bus.
If I am you, I take the bus.
If I were you, I will take the bus.
items.answer: If I were you, I'd take the bus.

items.en: If I ___ more time, I would read more books.
She'd come if you asked her.
options: Ela viria se você a convidasse.
items.answer: Ela viria se você a convidasse.

items.en: If I were you, I ___ worry.
If I lived abroad, I would miss Brazilian food.
What would you do if you were rich?
items.pt: O que você faria se fosse rico?

lines.en: Look! I bought a lottery ticket.
lines.pt: Olha! Comprei um bilhete da loteria.

lines.en: Really? What would you do if you won?
lines.pt: Sério? O que você faria se ganhasse?

lines.en: If I won, I ___ quit my job and travel.
lines.pt: Se eu ganhasse, largaria meu emprego e viajaria.

lines.en: I would go to Japan. If I ___ there, I would eat a lot!
lines.pt: Eu iria ao Japão. Se eu estivesse lá, comeria muito!

lines.ask: Para onde a Paula iria primeiro?

lines.en: And if I were you, I'd give some money to your best friend…
lines.pt: E se eu fosse você, daria um pouco de dinheiro para seu melhor amigo…

lines.en: Ha ha! Don't worry, I ___ forget you.
lines.pt: Ha ha! Não se preocupe, eu não te esqueceria.

lines.en: Good! Now we just have to wait for Saturday.
lines.pt: Ótimo! Agora é só esperar o sábado.

lines.ask: O Bruno quer que a Paula…
options: Dê um pouco de dinheiro para ele
Viaje com ele para o Japão
lines.answer: Dê um pouco de dinheiro para ele
lines.why: "I'd give some money to your best friend" — ele mesmo!

items.why: Histórias mostram o inglês em uso de verdade. Ouça cada fala, complete as lacunas e responda às perguntas no caminho.

items.q: O que a Paula faria com o emprego?
